title: VSift JSONL result event v1
description: One worker request's complete result in a job.batch --events jsonl stream (P11, ADR 0021), written as soon as the request ends: line is its 1-based line in the batch file (null in job.run), result is job-result.schema.json. A refused line has no result event; its request_finished lifecycle event carries the rejection. Never dropped; at most 64 KiB per line.
